tests.name: W12 worktree en labels preserve source, row identity, unique and proof vocabulary
W12 worktree br labels preserve source, row identity, unique and proof vocabulary
activity en copy formats measured values and category names
activity br copy formats measured values and category names
reading age cancels remote clock offsets and continues while a refresh is failing
a missing source is unread, never zero
owner is only the recorded session name
selecting a session does not fill an empty owner or change the string
a recorded spawn is the supervisor id, and an empty owner stays empty
a pid is not the address
inspection failure is unknown, not unread
the first sample and machine pressure stay unread
a filter miss is not an empty machine
tab names stay the closed English set
only recorded git worktrees enter the inventory, without inferred owners
Windows separators deduplicate without conflating distinct POSIX filenames
filter searches project and full path while preserving recorded facts
W09 manual requests use owned signals, coalesce, and admit only known row IDs
W09 late inventory success and failure cannot regress newer full readings or their age anchor
W09 concurrent full snapshots retain cumulative rows and compare decimal revisions exactly
W09 lifetime mismatch hides retired data, aborts old requests, and establishes only one fresh handshake
W09 failed replacement handshake remains explicit and a deliberate refresh retries
W09 disposal aborts pending GET and POST and ignores transport outcomes that disregard abort
W12 row failures stay per target, retries coalesce, and current failures retain facts and timestamps
W10 unread, complete zero and partial readings retain separate monotonic ages and named source
W10 missing and noncanonical wire revisions fail without replacing a successful inventory
W11 filtering preserves opaque cross-project rows, blank owners and registered facts
W12 retired same-ID completions cannot settle a replacement row's busy or failed action
the first snapshot leaves missing CPU unread and preserves other UI state
refreshing one instance preserves record identity and removes absent readings
a new instance discards old CPU and record identity even when record ids are reused
